subject: bia
title: BIA.------AFI.DY.
description: Diagram in WAM-24, the page where Braxton argues that 'the establishment of western art music as a composer's medium has given us the possibility to experience another viewpoint' — i.e., that the western alignment, despite its separations, produces a bi-aitional asset. (C)BIA (the *concept* of bi-aitional, Braxton's term for viewing the reality of principle information with respect to two basic vibrational continuums, the masculine and feminine vibrational principle) is crossed with AFI-DY (affinity-insight dynamics). The diagram routes BIA through TH-CONT-DY (thrust continuance dynamics) into AFI-DY; from that stretch AFI-DY branches into SOC-RT (social reality) → VT-AF-ATT (vibrational affinity/attitude) → VT-DY (vibrational dynamics), and into PHY-U-C (physical universe context) → PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). The structural claim: bi-aitionalism, when crossed with affinity-insight dynamics, organizes western culture's thrust-continuance into two parallel routes — one running through physical universe context into projectional dynamics, one through social reality and vibrational affinity/attitude into vibrational dynamics — and the diagram makes visible why these arms appear as separate viewpoints rather than as a unified center.
